messages:
Alex Chen: incoming escalation from Brightline — they say after we rolled redwood-model-7 their assistant answers feel 'clipped' and sometimes stop mid-list. customer says it started right after the model version bump and included side-by-side snippets. attaching their samples below.

Brightline sample (user prompt): 'List onboarding steps for a developer joining a new microservice repo.'

BEFORE (v6.x):
```
1) Fork the repo and run `make setup` to install deps.
2) Read CONTRIBUTING.md and the architecture doc in /docs.
3) Start the local dev server with `./scripts/dev.sh` and run unit tests under `tests/`.
4) Reach out to the owning team in #platform-team for infra questions.
5) Submit a small PR to add a README update; maintainers will review.
```
AFTER (v7):
```
1) Fork the repo and run `make setup`.
2) Read CONTRIBUTING.md.
3) Start the dev server.
```
Alex Chen: customer notes the "after" reply drops detail (no `/docs` path, no test guidance, no PR suggestion) and sometimes cuts off mid-sentence for longer prompts. they also provided request ids and timestamps for three invocations.

Kate Li: thanks Alex — can you paste the exact API call payloads (temperature, max_tokens, stop sequences, model param) and one of the request IDs? also what region / plan is this on (hosted/dedicated/private)?

Alex Chen: pasted here: model=redwood-model-7, temperature=0.0, max_tokens=300, top_p=1.0, streaming=false, stop=null. customer on hosted-us-west, org Brightline-Corp, plan=standard. request ids: r-2026022701, r-2026022707, r-2026022719 (timestamps 2026-02-27T14:02:11Z, 14:07:03Z, 14:19:45Z).

Jorge Martinez: @Kate @Alex tagging eng-ml — can you upload the user prompt + full response payloads (raw text) to the ticket? we need to check whether the model logits/k-decoding or early stop-signal changed. also, any recent decoding/stop-sequence changes in runtime?

runtime-bot: Canary deployment: redwood-runtime v3.9.1 with kernel patch K-192 merged and rolled to canary regions 2026-02-26T23:45Z. No stop-sequence behavior toggles in the runtime config for hosted.

Miriam Park: could be a subtle prompt-handling/headroom change after quantization adjustments or a tokenizer mapping tweak. Jorge — can we repro locally with the exact payload? if yes, run with streaming=true and with debug header X-Debug-Trace to capture where generation stopped (token index).

Jorge Martinez: reproducer command (run in staging):
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Debug-Trace: true" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-model-7","prompt":"List onboarding steps for a developer joining a new microservice repo.","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":300,"top_p":1.0}'
```

Jorge Martinez: initial quick run in staging returns truncated output matching customer; attaching debug trace shows generation halted at token index 62 with no stop token emitted — investigating whether early termination came from penalty/length heuristic.

Alex Chen: customer asked whether this is an intentional behavior change — they want rollback or mitigation. they want a short repro plan we can run and ETA on investigation.

Kate Li: plan: 1) eng-ml to investigate model changes between v6 -> v7 (tokenizer, training/eval changes) and sanity-check eval on our prompt set; 2) eng-runtime to confirm no new server-side early-abort heuristics; 3) support to collect 5 more failed examples from customer. expected initial update in 6-8 hours, full root-cause 48-72h.

Jorge Martinez: noted. I found a small change in the decoding scheduler PR that reduces max free-decoding steps for short-context prompts; revert candidate running in staging now. I'll post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: rollback job started for canary: redwood-runtime v3.9.0 -> v3.9.1-canary-revert at 2026-02-27T18:10Z.

Alex Chen: I'll tell Brightline we're reproducing, collecting more examples, and that we have a rollback candidate; they asked for priority — marked P1 in the ticket.

Miriam Park: if rollback eliminates the regression, we should schedule a model/regression postmortem and add prompt-based E2E checks to our pre-rollout test harness (compare semantic coverage of list-style answers).

Alex Chen: thanks all — will update customer and paste logs/request ids when rollback verification completes. :thumbsup:
